addr: 56 to 58 Oakover Road and 1 to 3 Newman Street
status: Lodged with the Minister for Planning, 15 Sep 2026
tag: On the park, seven kilometres from the city.
overview: Saint Village is 400 homes built to rent at full market rent, over a ground plane of retail, co-working, a members club and a wellness precinct. One owner. One operator. One standard. It sits on the park, 900 metres from Bell Station, in a tightly controlled planning precinct where new rental stock at this scale is genuinely rare.
stats: Plus a 141 m² residents’ work lounge
points: Podium-up views across the park to the city skyline.
Trams on St Georges Road, buses and bike lanes at the door.
A tightly controlled precinct. New rental stock at this scale is genuinely rare.
A park that keeps the view
Newman Reserve. An outlook that cannot be built out.
$7m invested in pre-approval. Lodged with the Minister for Planning on 15 September 2026.
why: National vacancy is 1.3 per cent and Melbourne 1.8, against a balanced market of 2.5 to 3.5
One building, one owner, one operator, with the State’s 50 per cent land tax concession for up to 30 years
A ground plane that earns: retail, 5IVE wellness, 7X co-working and a members club on the podium
Build price fixed at $160m by Hamilton Marino and checked by DrawDown Partners
Three ways in: development equity, a forward purchase, or co-investment
